notes.title: Update about PGM 2 and the future
notes.notes:
We know that a lot of you have questions about PGM and PGM2, here’s an update that hopefully will answer a few of them.

TL;DR. PGM 1 was broken, we’re sorry and we will give everyone a window of opportunity to get PGM 2, the full game for free.

Firstly, we do know that the original PGM went south in many ways. The idea that you all bought into was, and still is, strong, but the execution was lacking in so many ways. For that we are truly sorry and to compensate for this we’ve now decided to give everyone who’s bought the original PGM a window to download PGM2 for free, that means the full game through the whole development including the final product. Exactly when we’re ready to start releasing PGM2 is difficult to say right now, or even exactly how we’ll do this, we’re currently working on how to do make this happen in the best possible way.

As most of you know by now, the code we took over from the original developers was much too disorganized and full of half executed ideas for one developer to sort through as we tried initially so we’ve now truly started from scratch both team wise and code wise. And already we’re seeing the wisdom of that, with a new team of soon six people and someone new to work on the graphics we’re starting to see the game both you and we dream of take shape. It’s all baby steps at the moment, but we’re all feeling a new excitement for the project. 

We understand you all being upset and disappointed, to put it mildly, over buying a game that’s clearly underdeveloped, being given promises of something better, and then that falling way short of the mark. We hear you, and we’re doing everything to keep that from happening again. That’s why we’ve now sifted through all your feedback as well as our own ideas to build a solid plan for how to build a game that truly reflects the initial idea. To do that we’re building everything up methodically from scratch again.

So what does this mean? We’d love to tell you more but at the moment we’re still very much in the prototype stage and we don’t want to present things that might not make it into the final product and disappoint you again, so we want to wait to reveal more details until we feel we have that solid ground. All we can say is that we’re building something the original PGM for many reasons never could have been. And we hope that you guys will want to join us going forward. That’s why we’ve decided to give all existing owners of PGM a window to get a key to the new PGM, full game, when we’re ready to make that available. 

We’re currently working on our website to make that the heart of or communication with you. We’re also creating a forum to give you guys even better ways to stay involved in the development to make PGM2 into the awesome game we all want it to be. Stay tuned for more information as soon as we have it. 


/Eyoel Lundberg, Head of dev team

notes.title: Dev update
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Just wanted to give you an update on how things are going.

We’re deep into the production of prototypes for the pre-alpha and we’re really excited by what we’re seeing. We hope you will be too once it’s ready for debut outside our team.

We’ve taken all your feedback on board regarding our announcement on how we will proceed with PGM, ie that we’ll not be doing any more updates for the current PGM but focusing on doing PGM2. So, what can we do for you in that department here and now? 

We’ve decided to pull the DLC as it’s not really connected to the original game anyway. 
And we’re in the process of reducing the price of the game from $12.99 to $2.99.

Please keep your suggestions and other feedback coming and know that we read and consider everything.

We’ll update you all again as soon as we have something concrete to say.

/Dev team

notes.title: Patch notes 1.5.6.7
notes.notes:
We managed to squeeze in a quick patch before the holidays. Enjoy!

Added:
Time lock on fridge and computer when condition bars are too high or low.
NPCs will now play matches continuously throughout the 24 hours of the day.
You will now spend time while eating.
Time will now pass when you’re on the computer.
A match will now influence the time passed in the room proportionately.

Adjusted:
Values for hygiene, rage, energy and hunger.
Fast and Faster are no longer super speeded. Fastest is 1 sek = 10 min instead of 1 sek = 1 hour.

Fixed:
Removed language selection at the beginning.
Condition bars will no longer disappear when too high or low. 
Spelling errors.

Happy holidays!

notes.title: Latest dev news and Momento Temporis in full release!
notes.notes:
Hi Guys!

Here’s the latest update on the development.
 We’re piecing together the AI simulation for the FPS matches and we mostly have fine tuning left which we have our awesome beta testers to help out with.
 We’re working on implementing all kinds of cool stuff in the room such as a shop to do upgrades of gears and furniture. 
 We’ve also fleshed out the league and tournament systems to be more engaging and fun to play.
We also wanted to let you know that we yesterday launched Momento Temporis: Light from the Deep together with Burning Ice Games, an awesome 2D metroidvania, pixel-art, adventure, platformer. A real challenge to play, and lots of fun. And don’t worry, it’s being developed by the other studio so it doesn’t effect the PGM development. We’re helping out with the publishing parts. But if you want to support us, and the talented dev team behind Momento Temporis, don’t miss out on the release sale happening right now here.

And lastly, we at 501 Industries are trying to form a platform where we can talk about all our games in the same place, please join our Steam group here.

Have a great weekend!

/501 Industries

notes.title: About the New Dawn patch
notes.notes:
Hi Guys,

We’re so sorry.

There’s no way around that.

We’re really sorry to have let you down and that the new patch was not what you’d expected. We’re so fortunate to have such a strong and committed community, and we sincerely hope you can forgive us for the mistake last night and that you haven’t lost faith in the game and it’s future. We will do all we can to make this up to you with continued dialogue and transparency about what’s going with the development.

We truly want this to be a great game, therefore we’ve taken down the new patch so that we can continue working on it. The old version of the game is still there for all of you to enjoy and play. We will continue to give the game the love and care it deserves and perhaps more important, the time to become the game we all hope and dream. 

We really hate to disappoint you, and believe us, we’re our own hardest critic in all of this. We’re now sitting down, evaluating what happened last night and formulating a new plan for the continued development of the game.

Sincerely,
PGM dev team

notes.title: New patch, sale and a bundle
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

The day we’ve all been waiting for is finally here and we can show you what we’ve been working on and hinting about. The thoroughly reworked FPS career mode is live on Steam for all of you to play! It’s been a long road to get to this point, and we’re so grateful that you’ve stuck with us, and we’re convinced that it’s all worth it in the end. 

Please note that this is still early days in our total rebuild of the game. There will be some baby problems and stuff that’s missing, but we want to put it out to you guys now to test the simulation on a larger scale. Don’t worry, there’s still a lot more to come in the FPS career mode before we’re finished with it. 

Just a quick word about FPS manager mode and FOBA career and manager modes. These can still be played in the old part of the game which is currently being uploaded. These are not subject to any changes as we’re building everything new from scratch.

How to play the old PGM:
In your Steam game library, right click on the game and click on Properties.
Click on the Betas tab.
From the dropdown menu, choose "oldpgm".
Play!
How to switch back to the new PGM again:
Same as above, but choose NONE from the dropdown menu.

And now on to the new stuff. To make it easier for you guys to see all the changes we’ve done we’ve compiled a long list of patch notes. Enjoy! :) 

Added
 Completely reworked graphical design
 Customize the look of your character from a range of outfits and hairstyles
 Play as female, male or other
 Now available for both Mac and PC
 Steamplay (for the new rebuilt FPS)
 Expanded language support (Thanks to all our fans who made this possible.) 
Arabic
Czech
French
German
Greek
Hungarian
Italian
Korean
Polish
Portuguese
Russian
Spanish
Spanish (latinoamerican)
Swedish
Ukrainian
 Live match simulation
 Manage your hunger, sleep, hygiene and rage levels to maximize your gaming potential
 New inbox system where you can accept or decline invites as well as re-read the latest messages
 Overtime in matches
 NPC now buys weapons in between rounds

Fixed
 There should be no spelling or grammatical issues in the default English in the new part of the game 
 We’ve solved the issue of non matching NPC names. Before the nationality of the team didn’t always match the nationality if the gamers. The  NPC names. Before, a Danish team could consist of names of for instance, japanese player. 
 Teams no longer consists of  ten players. hey have five ordinary and one reserve.
 The randomness in games. There was an issue where a rank 95 team could lose against a rank 25 team. Now the game results are less based on luck and more on skill. - You should now, get picked for games in a team

Changed
 Increased the amount of save slots
 Auto-saves after every match.

Removed
 You can no longer purchase new houses 
 Intro sound in credit scenes

Other
 Reworked the entire Steam Page and description of the game
 New website featuring the new graphical design

Next Patch/Patches
 Sponsors
 Improved kitchen, choose between different foods and drinks to fuel your gamer
 More animations and improved UI
 Improved AI and match simulation
 Calenderevents
 Game tutorial
What about sale and bundle?
PGM is currently on a weeklong deal giving you 40% off. And to make the deal even sweeter, complete your 501 Industries games set by buying the bundle and get the awesome platformer Momento Temporis: Light from the Deep for next to nothing? 

Please send us your feedback, good and bad, we read everything and try to make the best game for everyone. If you notice bugs, language errors or things like that, please drop us a line at support@501Industries.com. 

Happy gaming!
Dev team

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

We can’t thank you enough for the tremendous feedback we’ve received on how to improve the game! Thank you so much! And now, we would like to share with you how far we've come in the progress of taking PGM to the next level.

We’ve worked really hard to push PGM to its limits and in doing that we’ve had to resculpture much of its code and design in order to make sure that we can hold the promises we have made in the past and to continue to make it even better in the future.

But (there’s always one, isn’t there), due to limited resources and respect for the product, we’ve chosen to focus our efforts on reworking just one of our game modes and this time that game mode is carreer mode - FPS. Why did we choose to do it this way? Because it would be too large of burden to rework everything at once and if we divide it up in smaller patches we can ensure quality and work with you guys to get the most out of PGM.

Now on to the good part - what can you actually expect from this upcoming patch?

Here’s is a list of new features and a sneak peek of the new PGM.

 A complete overhaul of the UI design. 
 Reworked code for the Battle simulation = No more randomness.
 Create your own unique character, with hair colour, clothing, gender and merch.
 Interactions in the room (The fridge might be a good thing to check out!). :)
 Random events that impacts your gaming progress.
 Improved ranking system.
 FPS (ah, this one you’re going to love) is now remade and no longer just a bar above the character, now you get to experience the simulation live.
 Control your need for sleep, food and hygiene.


Things that we will add in the next few upcoming patches:

 Localization and a complete rework of the current English version.
 Actual tournaments where you get to go to the arena in the city.
 Verified teams/players (More on this later).
 Mac-support.
 Steamplay.
 Controller Support.

The new patch is set to be released in September and as we move closer to completion of the patch we will give you more details of what the patch will include as well as a heads up on exactly when it will be released.

As we mentioned, we haven’t forgotten about you guys who loves the FOBA game mode or enjoys the manager part of the game, but we had to start somewhere and Career Mode FPS was the one that we felt need the most love.


And finally, as promised - screenshots! Please note that these are still a work in progress and only Career Mode FPS. Enjoy your day! :)

The awesome new UI design.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10457968/4320eadb710067a299cdf3a6f47fe5e08373be55.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10457968/99a1c577ed5895ab6958dc449e2f083552bf8265.jpg

If there are things you would love to see in the upcoming patches, please send us a loving email to support@501Industries.com, tweet or chat with us here on Steam or our Discord Channel. We love to hear your ideas for the game. 

Dev team, 501 Industries

notes.title: PGM Update News
notes.notes:
Good news everyone!

We’re happy to announce that 501 Industries, as publishers of PGM, will take on a more active role in the future development of the game.

This means, among other things, that they will add more resources in terms of manpower in the developing team as well as planning and structuring the future work to help us deliver better updates.

PGM is a big game, we're a small team and dealing with two different game modes has been overwhelming at times. This is a huge step forward in our efforts to try and make this game as awesome as we all want it to be. But most importantly, it will also help us to maintain a more open and transparent communication with the community.

Help us make the game better!
We’d love to hear from you about what you'd like to see in the game in the future. Any and all feedback is most welcome and will help shape the direction of further development. Please don’t hesitate to send your comments to support@501Industries.com

Thank you for your continued support and understanding!

notes.title: Update #175 is now live, PGM to be released April 29th!
notes.notes:
Introducing Staff assignments, ManagerPhone, Transfermarket, Gaminghouse Events & Characters, Bootcamps, Investments, Internet Celebs, Reserve Team, Talk to players, Advanced FPS tactics, Custom team names and much more. Most features and fixes in this update has been suggested by the community.	

We are very pleased to announce that PGM will be released for PC on April 29th. It’s been an amazing journey through Early Access and we’re super excited to give you this special content update. PGM is now ready to take the next step and reach out to a wider audience.

To all those players that gave us feedback, and those that shared their thoughts and impressions in the past 10 months, big thanks to everyone! Your continued support and enthusiasm has been amazing.

Development will continue after release, we still have tons of new features and content that we want to get into the game, including tutorial and glossary codex for both gamemodes, support for atleast 4-5 more languages and achievements, so stay tuned for regular updates here on Steam. 

We cannot thank you guys enough for your contribution so far to the game, and for inspiring us to continue development and make this possible. Make sure you stop by the forums to give us your feedback so we can hear where you want PGM to go next!
